sets.title: Non-breaking space (NBSP) in indentation
sets.description: Tests whether non-breaking space characters (U+00A0) used as indentation confuse tokenizers. NBSP looks like space but is a different character code. Infrastructure gap: SetBuilder does not support ENC-02 NBSP transform.

sets.title: Unicode identifiers ($日本語 variable names)
sets.description: Tests whether multibyte identifiers confuse clone detection. PHP allows unicode identifiers per RFC 6537. Infrastructure gap: SetBuilder seed payloads use ASCII identifiers only. Note: if seed doesn't support unicode vars, this set documents the gap.

sets.title: Mixed EOL styles (CRLF vs LF within same file)

sets.title: Compound encoding anomalies (BOM + WS-10 newline style)

sets.title: Drift chain A(pristine) → B(A+WS-03) → C(B+RN-05) → D(C+CM-03)
